requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml registers SupportAgent and loadSupportInstruction, declares no support tools, and records open-request-tools as unresolved. src/support-agent.ts directly calls streamText while spreading createRuntimeTools() into tools.

moldea/moldea.yaml registers only StepSupportAgent for step-support and has no instructionLoader binding. src/step-support-agent.ts directly calls streamText and permits prepareStep to replace instructions.

Canonical state preserves delegate_support registration, implementation, and input/output schemas without any handoff or routing declaration. src/delegation.ts merely references StepSupportAgent through an ordinary function implementation. Workspace assertions show all relevant source files unchanged.

IndirectSupportAgent and UnsupportedOutputAgent remain in their unchanged source files but are absent from moldea/moldea.yaml. Their source respectively places generation behind a helper and uses Output.array.

src/workflow-agent.mts still defines RuntimeInitializedAgent with executable initializedAt = Date.now(), while moldea/moldea.yaml does not register it. Workspace assertions confirm the source file was unchanged.

Support and step-support both reference /moldea/runtimes/cloudflare-agents.md, and workspace evidence establishes it as the sole new runtime guide. The guide addresses Durable Object bindings, SQLite migration, provider binding, Worker entrypoint/routes, and deployment verification, but contains no static alternatives for closing the open-tools or prepareStep boundaries.

moldea/moldea.yaml contains a focused open-request-tools warning with /src/support-agent.ts and a resolution, but step-support has no unresolved entry describing prepareStep instruction replacement, no related /src/step-support-agent.ts path, and no corresponding resolution.
